title: One-Pot Garlic Butter Chicken Rigatoni in Parmesan Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, sliced into thick strips
1/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, optional
instructions: Season the chicken with Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil and 1 tbsp butter in a large deep skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes until deeply golden with seared edges and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate.
Reduce heat to medium and melt the remaining butter in the same skillet. Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream, scraping up the browned bits from the pan.
Add the uncooked rigatoni. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook for 12 to 14 minutes, stirring occasionally, until pasta is tender.
Stir in the cream cheese until smooth, then add Parmesan and mozzarella. Stir until melted into a thick, glossy sauce.
Return the chicken to the skillet and coat with the sauce. Let simmer 1 to 2 minutes until everything is fully combined and creamy.
Finish with parsley, red pepper flakes, and extra Parmesan.
notes: Calories: approx. 780 per serving. Source page is an AI-content recipe account ("Homemade Cooking Recipes") on Facebook; full recipe was found in the author's own comment on the post rather than the caption.
